statement: A tree is given as: a line with n, then a line of n level-order entries where -1 marks an absent child; each placed node consumes the next two entries as its left and right children. Print the level order traversal - the values floor by floor, left to right within each floor - as space-separated values. Use a queue: seed it with the root; repeatedly serve a node, record its value, and enqueue its existing children. Children join at the back while parents leave from the front, so floors come out in order automatically.
constraints: Node values are positive; -1 marks an absent child.

example.why: Floor one holds 1, floor two holds 2 and 3, floor three holds 4 and 5.

hint: The queue does the ordering; your loop only serves, records and enqueues.
mistake: Using a stack out of reflex - last in, first out visits the tree depth-first instead.
